summary: Re-tested the AssetFlow Campus backend modules and authenticated responsive UI. All 7 pytest checks and the focused admin, booking, theme, mobile navigation, and audit browser flow passed.
action_items: Consider adding server-side non-empty validation for department/category names before production.
critical_code_review_comments: OAuth callback path remains an external-provider flow and was not exercised interactively; verify it against the provider environment before release.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MODULE-prefixed department/category and a temporary future booking; booking was cancelled during the test. Existing regression test also creates TEST_API maintenance data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin and Asset Manager credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public endpoint and browser checks passed. Admin console, booking overlap, audit close, no-dues load, accreditation format, activity persistence, mobile audit navigation, and dark theme were exercised.
rca of the issue: No unresolved defect reproduced in this iteration. Prior activity serialization concern is no longer reproducible: activity endpoint returned 200 during pytest and UI flows.
